name: Rosemon
main_effect:
＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By suspending 1 Digimon or Tamer, until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to 1 of your suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits or the [CS] trait.
